title: Reach a Cartesian target with a controlled arm
prompt: Edit robot.xml so that the named end_effector moves from at least 0.50 m away to the Cartesian target [0.557365, 0.573885, 0.500000] metres when the protected grader commands the shoulder position actuator to 0.8 radians for 1,000 MuJoCo steps. Preserve the shoulder joint, shoulder_position actuator, and end_effector site names and keep them in one connected control chain. Success requires a final Euclidean target error no greater than 0.02 m. The grader loads and executes the submitted MJCF; declarations or stored success flags do not count.
